title: Litoral Pavilion 11 connecting roof sections
visualBrief: Complete intrinsic uncovered roof section(s) of original numerical 6792W3X4+M945 adjoining existing Litoral halls, preserving all 4/11/3derived outline corners and every source remainder. Existing bodies cover the bound subtracted areas and remain unchanged. Exact building/room function, physical join, boundary alignment and2023condition unverified; this asset is not a whole-prison or independent-building proxy. Original full-precision Google WKT and exact polygon-set difference retained, source confidence0.8410 is a model rank, not an accuracy probability. Existing source masks exclude perimeter/site rings; no roof is made from a yard boundary. Own original field must precede floor/mainsections. All images unused, Qualla first single unrelated portrait. Plan/height/finish/floor census/interface/grade estimates explicit; historical2023continuity unverified. Every complete exact original source-set difference piece retained, 4/11/3corners with areas38.4329/386.4448/4.6794m². Original full Google polygon and bound accepted roof masks preserved. These are intrinsic adjoining roof sections; no standalone independent new-building identity claimed. Initial floor selected after own field, before geometry: median of bound accepted neighboring absolute floor values10.7046/11.0032/11.25m gives11.0032m; own source datum11m gives local floor0.0032m. This is an original interface approximation, not a surveyed common datum or post-render grade/height fit. Numerical2023learned outside-section source samples per piece 2/21/0; medians6/5.5/absentm. Relative heights are source estimates, not floor census or survey. Initial roof/sections derive from these nominal heights;3m height/component and10m horizontal allowances, or5m height for sparse/absent sections, are modeling allowances, not measured error bounds. Original source confidence0.8410 is an automated rank, not a probability or proof of each small boundary strip. All full-source/mask boundaries and exact2023continuity remain approximate. The tiny4.6794m²triangular M945remainder has no qualified height observations. Where present it is preserved as a0.12m roof-edge slab adjoining the bound accepted southeast block, with upper surface0.16m above its original absolute roof, no new tall wall/room/door/floor or claimed source height. Other end and main sections remain complete closed volumes. Facade/window/entry/canopy/roof material/color/section profiles, compartment use and precise2023condition are conservative original estimates. Patches meet accepted bodies with unmeasured interfaces; no repair to or duplicate of existing model bodies. No interiors or source-photo texture. Own original256m129x129 source field/raw tile acquired before floors/mainsections. Source field/frame/initial floors/sections frozen without masks, flattening, cutout, fitting or relocation. Coarse contact and exact historic grade/vertical tie remain unsurveyed. All images, plans, figures, artwork and source pixels unused. Qualla-first single unrelated portrait excluded. Four complete authored levels retain all intrinsic pieces and major outline/roof/entry/opening census; near levels refine opening recesses and bars. Whole prison remains unfinished.
